selfplay.about: PPO from scratch vs frozen snapshots of itself (M1/MPS, corrected training semantics). At 3M the net is 10-22 vs GNU Go levels 1-10 — but almost all of that is White (8-8); as Black it is 2-14. First-move play is the known weakness, not training time.
